name: EkOnKar
description:
Multi-Language & Bilingual Word Wheel App Prompt

    Build a complete, responsive, single-page web application for a multilingual "Word Wheel" (Rueda de Palabras) puzzle game with a dedicated Bilingual Mode.

    1. Supported Languages & Language Switcher

        Include a clean language selector in the top header supporting English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian (Cyrillic), and Japanese (Hiragana/Katakana), structured cleanly so new language packs can be added as modular JSON dictionaries.

        Bilingual Mode Toggle: Allow players to pick a Target Language (the language of the puzzle wheel) and a Support Language (their native/reference language). When Bilingual Mode is enabled:

            Every found word displays a live translation badge and part-of-speech tag in the Support Language.

            Optional "Translation Hints" reveal the Support Language meaning of unfound words as clues.

            UI labels and toast notifications can display in either language or dual-language subtitles.

    2. Core Gameplay & Alphabet Handling

        The Wheel: Render an interactive circular 9-letter wheel with 1 mandatory center tile (highlighted in a distinct accent color) and 8 outer tiles arranged symmetrically around it.

        Word Rules: Players form valid words in the active Target Language using only the wheel's tiles. Words must be at least 3 or 4 characters long (configurable), include the center tile, and use each tile at most once per word.

        Diacritics & Special Characters: Automatically handle language-specific letters (Ñ, Ç, ß, Ø, Ł) and normalize diacritics (Á/É/Í/Ó/Ú, Ä/Ö/Ü, À/È/Ê/Ô, Ã/Õ) during validation so players can type on standard or native keyboards without friction.

        Input & Controls: Support clicking/tapping wheel tiles as well as physical keyboard typing (Backspace to delete, Enter to submit, Space to shuffle outer tiles), plus on-screen Submit, Delete, Clear, and Shuffle buttons.

    3. Built-in Dictionaries & Curated Puzzles

        Bundle at least 10 curated 9-character pangram puzzles and a self-contained dictionary for each supported language (e.g., MARIPOSAS in Spanish, AVENTURES in French, ABENTEUER in German, AVVENTURA in Italian, AVENTURAS in Portuguese, ADVENTURE in English) with cross-language translation mappings so the app works immediately offline with zero external API keys.

        Track total possible words, current score, pangram bonus badges, and localized rank titles (e.g., Beginner / Principiante / Débutant / Anfänger).

    4. "Remix" Multilingual Custom Wheel Builder

        Include a "Remix / Create Wheel" modal where users choose a Target Language, enter any 9-character base word, and select the center tile.

        Automatically compute all valid words from that language's dictionary and generate a shareable URL hash/code that encodes both the custom wheel and the selected language pair.

    5. UI, Polish & Persistence

        Editorial Design: Clean, distraction-free layout with light/dark themes, smooth tile animations, subtle shake + localized error toasts ("Missing center letter", "Already found", "Not in dictionary"), and confetti on finding the 9-letter pangram.

        Progress Tracking: Save separate progress, stats, and streak counters per language in localStorage, plus a "Reveal Answers" end-of-round summary showing all missed words alongside their Bilingual Mode translations.
